extraction_notes: Single-part datasheet from Zhuhai Hongjiacheng Technology co., Ltd (www.ichjc.com); top-level manufacturer preserves the exact job identity hongjiacheng.

Curves were digitized from a 300 dpi render of page 2 with pixel calibration against the printed axis gridlines (Fig. 1: VF 0-0.8 V linear, IF 0.01-2 A log; Fig. 2: VR 0-40 V linear, IR 1e-4 to 10 mA log; Fig. 3: VR 0-20 V linear, CT 0-300 pF linear). Decade and tick positions were cross-checked against minor gridlines before reading points. Estimated reading uncertainty is about +/-0.005 V on Fig. 1 and a few percent on Fig. 2 and Fig. 3 values.
Fig. 2 and Fig. 3 y-values were converted from the printed mA and pF axis units to SI amperes and farads.

Some sample voltages in Fig. 2 and Fig. 3 are offset slightly from round gridline values (for example 10.5 V, 20.4 V, 5.1 V) because the curve stroke merges with the vertical gridline exactly on the line; the offset column position is recorded honestly in the x value.

The digitized Fig. 1 typical curve reads about 0.482 V at IF = 1.0 A, essentially coincident with the table maximum of 0.48 V; the table row and the instantaneous typical curve use different measurement bases on this datasheet, and both are recorded as printed.

The electrical characteristics table also lists a maximum reverse current of 0.02 mA at VR = 15 V; the required reverse_current field records the rated-blocking-voltage row (0.05 mA at VR = 30 V, stored as 5.0e-5 A).
No capacitance row exists in the electrical characteristics table; the capacitance scalar is read from the Fig. 3 typical curve at VR = 4.0 V (100 pF = 1.0e-10 F).

Absolute maximum ratings on p. 1: VRRM = 30 V, VRMS = 21 V, VDC = 30 V, IF(AV) = 1.0 A, IFSM = 30 A at t = 8.3 ms half-sine, PD = 350 mW, Tj = 125 degC, Tstg = -55 to +150 degC, RthJA = 222 degC/W. These ratings are not breakdown characterization data.
Fig. 4 is a power-derating rating curve, not a device IV or capacitance characteristic, and is not digitized.
extraction.omission_reason: The datasheet publishes no reverse-recovery time and no reverse-breakdown characterization; reverse_recovery, breakdown_voltage, and breakdown_current remain null.
